quote: When the silence stretches out too long, you begin to question every single choice. Memories return like ghosts through broken windows, touching places you thought were healed. People leave behind quiet echoes in empty rooms, teaching you how deeply absence hurts. You carry the weight of unsaid words, wondering if anyone noticed you slipping away. In the end, we are all just looking for a light that stays.
